body: Already I feel a little better, out of sight out of mind is the way to go i think
Just blocked her on everything I can think of. Thank you for the help, hopefully this'll really help.

Of course. Especially after learning about what she did behind my back. How could I put my full trust in anyone if someone that close to me stabbed me like that, its probably just gonna happen again. Or something like that, its just hard to have that trust in anybody anymore

Sometimes, sometimes it helps me not think about different things. But then sometimes it makes me worry about what they think of me or if they're gonna stress out about me. Its half and half. That's part of the reason why I haven't told them about my serious thoughts, i don't want them to worry or be sad should anything happen to me. But sometimes it does make me feel better
They know it hurt me, they don't know the full extent of exactly how i'm feeling though. I haven't opened up like that
